idea-plugin.name: Commit Mate
idea-plugin.description:
Commit Mate generates Conventional Commits style commit messages from the staged changes of your Git repository, using any OpenAI Chat Completions compatible API (DeepSeek by default). You review, edit and copy the generated message, then commit it yourself.

The plugin only runs read-only commands such as git diff --cached. It never executes git add, git commit or git push, and never modifies files in your working tree.

  • OpenAI compatible endpoints (default DeepSeek: https://api.deepseek.com/v1)
  • API key is stored in the IntelliJ Platform PasswordSafe, never in plain configuration files
  • Supports multi-repository projects and add/modify/delete/rename statistics
  • Oversized diffs are truncated with an explicit warning instead of silently dropped

插件读取当前 Git 仓库的暂存区变更，调用 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容接口生成提交信息， 最终由开发者自行审核、修改与提交。

action.description: 打开 Commit Mate 对话框（不会执行任何 Git 写操作）
针对勾选的变更生成提交信息并填入提交框（再点一次取消）
